parts.label: (i)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Coefficient of x is $80$ — B2

Correct value must be selected for both marks.

SR: $+80$ seen in an expansion gets B1, or $-80$ gets B1 if selected.

[2]

steps.guidance: Correct value must be selected for both marks. SR: $+80$ seen in an expansion scores B1; selected $-80$ scores B1.

rows.guidance: Correct value must be selected for both marks. SR: $+80$ seen in an expansion scores B1; selected $-80$ scores B1.

criteria.guidance: Correct value must be selected for both marks. SR: $+80$ seen in an expansion scores B1; selected $-80$ scores B1.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
$Coefficient of \frac1x=-40 in the binomial expansion$ — B2

Correct value seen or implied in (ii); powers may be unsimplified only if selected.

Coefficient of x is $(1\times80)+(3\times-40)=-40$ — M1 A1

M1 links the appropriate two terms only.

SR: $+40$ seen or implied in (ii) gets B1.

[4]
